title: Trinity flash explained away as an ammo dump accident

tellings.quote: wondering what had happened and then the government saying, "Oh, we had a accident in an ammo dump."

plain: When the first atomic bomb was tested in the New Mexico desert in 1945, a test called Trinity, people who saw the flash were left wondering what had happened, and the government told them, "Oh, we had an accident in an ammo dump." The story comes from John Brandenburg, a scientist who argues that life on ancient Mars was wiped out by nuclear war, and he passes it on as something he was told. He tells it as an early case of officials covering up something huge with a dull everyday excuse.
